'''Kontsuma''' is the largest populated settlement on the island of [[Kamio]], a small island located in the [[South Sea]]. One year prior to the [[Battle of Mount Hyjal]]<ref>{{Neutral}} [11] [[Troubles From Distant Lands]]</ref>, the naga began to encroach upon their civilization, and the people of Kontsuma now look for help from the rest of the world.
